name: code-quality-subagent
description: Specialized sub-agent configuration for auditing code quality, TypeScript type safety, React component architecture, and CSS conventions across the codebase.
responsibilities: Verify TypeScript strict type safety and eliminate any unused variables, parameters, or implicit any types
Ensure React best practices, including proper hook dependencies, unmount cleanup, and state colocation
Inspect component styling to confirm adherence to Tailwind CSS utility conventions and prevent unwanted arbitrary values
Verify that locked section geometry styles and calibrated layout paddings remain untouched
Ensure zero compile warnings or errors in frontend (tsc && vite build) and backend (mvn test)

checks.checkDescription: Confirm locked padding and margin classes (e.g., pt-[26.4px] pb-8, gap-5, pt-8 pb-[50.8px], pt-12 pb-[45.8px], mb-[24.1px]) are strictly preserved
Verify no unused imports or variables remain in modified components

constraints: Do NOT introduce new third-party dependencies without explicit authorization
Do NOT alter business logic or established UI geometry during quality audits
Maintain complete documentation integrity and preserve all existing comments and docstrings
